THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF BURNETT TERRACE CONDOMINIUMS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT RECOLOGY SF $2,961.55 PRINCIPAL, $90.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,051.55, PLAINTIFF ESTABLISHED BY A PREPONDERANCE OF THE EVIDENCE THAT DEFENDANT'S DRIVER CAUSED THE CLAIMED DAMAGES AND PLAINTIFF IS AWARDED THE AMOUNTS CLAIMED.
